# The ultimate foodie event is just around the corner!





Five days of sweet treats in Paris: tastings, demonstrations, and gatherings centered around chocolate and pastries.



See you from October 28 to November 1, 2026!





[Discover the show](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/en/paris/the-show/presentation-salon-du-chocolat)



[Get my ticket](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/en/paris/practical-info/buy-my-ticket?o=ADLG-ORGANIQUE_SITEWEB-ORGANIC)

## Choco'Live: chocolate, live



Every day, competitions, chef masterclasses and family activities follow one another, offering a new way to discover, learn and share around chocolate and pastry.ance between craftsmanship, credibility, and innovation. Each bar tells a unique story, offering consumers an authentic experience that fully justifies its price.

[Learn more](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/en/paris/the-show/musical-show)

A new edition is in the works.

## Ticket sales are now open!

From October 28 to November 1, 2026, the most indulgent culinary experience of the year returns to Paris.

For five days, immerse yourself in a world where cocoa, pastry, and creativity come together as one. Chefs, artisans, and enthusiasts from around the globe gather to share what makes chocolate so exciting today.

[Get my ticket!](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/en/paris/practical-info/buy-my-ticket?o=ADLG-ORGANIQUE_SITEWEB-ORGANIC)

## A glimpse of the experience

The Salon du Chocolat & de la Pâtisserie in Paris brings together the people who breathe life into chocolate today: artisans, chefs, creators, and enthusiasts from around the world. On stage, in the aisles, at every moment, craftsmanship is on display, creations are unveiled, and emotions are shared. What you discover here is just a glimpse of what awaits you.

[Discover all videos](https://www.youtube.com/@mondialduchocolat)

## Highlights of the show

![Zoom in on a pastry depicting a forest of fir trees sprinkled with powdered sugar.](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/-/media/Project/Comexposium-Master1/Master1-Chocolat/paris/home/pg-Salon-du-Chocolat-Pastry-Show-chefs-Elisabeth-Hot-et-Angelo-Musa.jpg?rev=5d6cee0f9d2746a493c4f28680677427&w=700&hash=8D62647CC2728F9AF8EF77ECA28B6F25)

## The Pastry Show

A signature event, the pastry show shines the spotlight on the world’s greatest pastry chefs and master chocolatiers through exclusive live demonstrations.
A unique opportunity to discover the techniques, artistry and inspiration behind their creations.

[Learn more](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/en/paris/the-show/pastry-show-live-recipes)

![Model wearing a chocolate dress during the fashion show.](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/-/media/Project/Comexposium-Master1/Master1-Chocolat/paris/home/pg-Salon-du-Chocolat-Cacao-Show-Defile-Jour.jpg?rev=6b3572a5f8b84130a98327fa9efa222e&w=700&hash=782303B21872B897EB304D1F6D092F29)

## Musical Show

To celebrate 30 years, the salon’s legendary chocolate fashion show is evolving into a festive musical performance, where chocolate takes center stage in a joyful and creative celebration.

[Learn more](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/en/paris/the-show/musical-show)

![Dressage pastry being made.](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/-/media/Project/Comexposium-Master1/Master1-Chocolat/paris/home/pg-Atelier-dressage-patissier-chocolat.jpg?rev=437b49aca66641e68643dc82464fc855&w=700&hash=22BE5C10B0A5CFDDDD2FDE2FD617FA1C)

## Live experiences

From exclusive behind-the-scenes cooking moments and delicious tastings to surprising discoveries and insightful conversations, this edition promises a program full of emotion, delight and unforgettable memories for all ages.

[Learn more](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/en/paris/the-show/live-experiences)

![Focus on Nina Métayer's pastries.](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/-/media/Project/Comexposium-Master1/Master1-Chocolat/paris/home/pg-Chocolat-Espace-Cake-Time_Nina-Metayer.jpg?rev=1890959b6ffb46a8a0aa69affea18db1&w=700&hash=79BD7DDE21A84C927961D81723E1A0C1)

## Discovery areas

Immerse yourself in the world of chocolate and patisserie through our dedicated areas! The Signatures Pavilion, where you can sample creations by the world’s leading chefs; the International Destinations Pavilion, where you can travel whilst staying in Paris; the ‘En Résidence’ area…

[Learn more](https://www.salon-du-chocolat.com/en/paris/the-show/discovery-areas)
